announcements.title: Parenting Seminar | Saturday, November 7, 9am-11:30am
announcements.description:
CPC Fellowship Hall | Light Breakfast | Childcare provided.
Young and older/wiser parents are all welcome to attend. We’re hoping for helpful cross-pollination among all stages of parenting. There will be time for discussion, collaboration, and prayer.

announcements.title: Interested in Joining the Body of Christ at CPC?
announcements.description:
We consider the church an essential element of the gospel, so joining CPC as a member is a way to truly join the body of Christ, in all its blessings and with all its flaws! Before joining, you’ll meet one-on-one with a pastor and then discuss how you’ve come to know Christ with the Shepherd Leaders. Contact Alexis at admin@cpcnewhaven.org to begin the process.
NOTE THE DATE CHANGE: Our next joining will take place on Sunday, November 15.

announcements.title: Thanksgiving Fellowship Meals | Sign Up Here as Host or Guest | Thursday, November 26
announcements.description: Staying local for Thanksgiving? Come celebrate with your brothers and sisters in Christ! As we’ve done in the past, we’re coordinating hosts and guests to have a Thanksgiving meal together on November 26. If you’re interested, please email admin@cpcnewhaven.org or fill out the form.

announcements.title: Pastor Drop-in Office Hours | Craig, Fridays 7:30-10:30am | Jerry, Wednesdays Noon-3:00pm | Other hours available upon request
announcements.description: Drop in for a casual time of discussion, Q&A, prayer, coffee, tea, really whatever you want to make it! If you have a more private or formal need, you’re always welcome to set up a separate time with Pastor Craig (craig.luekens@cpcnewhaven.org), or Pastor Jerry (jerry.ornelas@cpcnewhaven.org) but this is meant to be a space where anyone can drop in.

announcements.title: Women’s Discipleship Group | Monday, October 19 | Virtual
announcements.description: We’ll be going through the book Side by Side by Edward T. Welch. This is an opportunity to encourage and challenge one another as we seek to follow Christ by loving those around us! We meet virtually on the first and third Mondays of each month at 7:30pm. If interested, please reach out to Lisa Graham (lisahgraham44@gmail.com) or Diane Miller (auntiediane@att.net).

announcements.title: Life Groups and Discipleship Groups
announcements.description:
Life Groups and Discipleship Groups are our way of doing “church in the small” where we meet throughout Greater New Haven to be engaged in prayer, teaching, fellowship and care.
For information on which Life Group may be a good fit, contact Alexis at admin@cpcnewhaven.org.

announcements.title: CPC Mercy Ministry Care Teams | Complete the interest form here
announcements.description: CPC Care Teams have been created to serve as church-wide care for anyone in our congregation with a need. You can sign up for a team that matches your serving-ability or skill set, so that people at CPC are aware of the resources and gifts we have within our family, and thus can lean upon one another. Complete the interest form.
